description: This file defines the LeaveTypeMenuConfigurator class which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items related to leave types in the OrangeHRM system. It uses a trait for module and screen helper functionalities and overrides the screen for leave type listing.

classes.name: LeaveTypeMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu options related to leave types in the OrangeHRM application by modifying the screen to 'leaveTypeList'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'leaveTypeList' for the current module, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface method.
